description: This bar chart, from the paper "Continual Dialogue State Tracking via Reason-of-Select Distillation," illustrates the average JGA Score for two models—LLaMA-7B (orange bars) and T5-small (yellow bars)—across 27 consecutive turns, labeled as Turn ID from 0 to 26 along the horizontal axis. The vertical axis, labeled "Avg. JGA Score," ranges from 0.2 to 1.0 in increments of 0.1, indicating a linear scale. Each Turn ID has two adjacent bars, one for each model, allowing for direct comparison of their performance at that turn. The orange LLaMA-7B bars are consistently taller than the yellow T5-small bars across all turns, with the highest scores occurring at Turn 0 (LLaMA-7B: ~0.96, T5-small: ~0.95) and the lowest scores at Turn 26 (LLaMA-7B: ~0.45, T5-small: ~0.33). The bars are not sorted, and no visual emphasis such as shading or bolding is applied to any specific bar. The chart uses a legend in the upper right to distinguish the two models, with orange representing LLaMA-7B and yellow representing T5-small.
